streeR

streeR fits oblique classification trees: decision trees whose internal node splits are support vector machine (SVM) hyperplanes rather than thresholds on a single variable. Multi-class problems are handled directly at every node with a one-vs-rest strategy, following the STree algorithm of Montanana, Gamez and Puerta (2021).

Installation 

# From CRAN (once published):
install.packages("streeR")

# Development version from GitHub:
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("AneeshAgarwala/streeR")

Example 

library(streeR)

fit <- stree(Species ~ ., data = iris, max_depth = 3)
fit
#> STree oblique classification tree
#> Call:  stree(formula = Species ~ ., data = iris, max_depth = 3)
#> ...

predict(fit, iris[1:5, ])
predict(fit, iris[1:5, ], type = "prob")

See vignette("streeR-intro") for a fuller walkthrough.

Reference

Montanana, R., Gamez, J. A., Puerta, J. M. (2021). STree: A Single Multi-class Oblique Decision Tree Based on Support Vector Machines. In Advances in Artificial Intelligence, LNAI 12882, Springer. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-85713-4_6
